name: Kimi K2.6
short: Moonshot AI's open-weight 1.06T/32B multimodal MoE with 262K context for long-horizon coding and 300-agent swarms; live, $0.95/$4.00.
standout: The open-weight swarm specialist: a trillion-parameter multimodal MoE proven with 300-agent orchestration runs, at moderate API pricing.
tradeoff: A comparatively short context window and heavy local footprint keep it behind the newer K3 generation for long-context work.
